content.title: View stored High or Low priority badge on a task card
content.intent: Prove that a task with an explicit stored priority shows that same allowed value on its badge for the non-default allowed values.
content.technique_notes: Equivalence partitioning across the explicit allowed priority values named in the PRD. Covered with covering_array over input stored_priority using requested strength=2 from low-risk, non-money, non-auth, non-data-loss behavior; tool degraded to effective strength=1 because there is only one input. No separate negative path was minted because the corpus does not specify invalid-priority handling or a way to create an invalid value through this use-case.
